visual.headline: Real-time maritime intelligence for Indonesian waters
visual.description: Track vessels from AIS, detect safety risks and illegal activity, and manage fleet emissions from one operations console.

login.title: Sign in to the console
login.subtitle: Use your organization account to access AIS Maritime Intelligence.
login.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
login.loggedOut: You have been signed out safely.
login.help: No account yet? Ask your organization admin for an invitation.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.expired: The verification timed out. Please sign in again.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account e-mail. We will send a link to create a new password.
forgot.success: If {{email}} is registered, a password reset link has been sent. The link is valid for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Create a new password
reset.subtitle: At least 10 characters, with letters and digits.
reset.success: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.
reset.missingTokenDescription: The reset link has no token. Open the link from your e-mail again or request a new one.

invite.title: Activate your account
invite.subtitle: You were invited to AIS Maritime Intelligence. Create a password to activate your account.
invite.success: Your account is active. Please sign in.

errors.invalidMfaCode: The verification code is wrong or has expired.
errors.accountDisabled: Your account is disabled. Contact your organization admin.
errors.invalidToken: The link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
errors.throttledNoTime: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.
